Rose Laboratories ("we," "us," "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through roselaboratories.com (the "Website"), how we use it, and the choices you have. By using the Website, you agree to the practices described here.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information in the following ways:

  • Account information — name, email address, and phone number when you register for an account.
  • Order request information — shipping address, contact details, and the products you add to your cart, when you submit an order request.
  • Contact, B2B, and careers form submissions — details you provide via our Contact, B2B/OEM, and Careers & Partnerships pages, including business and professional information where relevant.
  • Conversations with our AI assistants — messages you send to Rose Prakriti Consultant or Rose Careers & Partner Connect, including any health, business, or personal details you choose to share.
  • Technical information — browser type, device information, and usage data collected automatically as you browse.

2. How We Use Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Create and manage your account.
  • Process and follow up on order requests, including confirming pricing and availability.
  • Respond to enquiries submitted via our Contact, B2B/OEM, and Careers & Partnerships pages.
  • Operate and improve our AI assistants and the Website generally.
  • Comply with legal and regulatory obligations applicable to a pharmaceutical manufacturer.

We do not use your information to make automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects without human review.

3. Our AI Assistants

Rose Prakriti Consultant and Rose Careers & Partner Connect are AI-powered assistants built on third-party large language model technology. When you chat with either assistant:

  • Your messages are sent to our server and, in turn, to our AI technology provider to generate a response.
  • Rose Prakriti Consultant provides educational Ayurvedic wellness information only — it is not a medical professional, does not diagnose conditions, and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
  • Rose Careers & Partner Connect collects details for recruitment and partnership enquiries — submitting information through it does not guarantee employment, distributorship, franchise rights, or partnership approval.
  • Please avoid sharing sensitive personal information (such as financial account numbers) in either chat.

4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with:

  • Service providers who help us operate the Website (e.g., hosting, our AI technology provider, and — once integrated — a payment gateway and logistics partners).
  • Regulatory or government authorities, where required by applicable law.
  • A successor entity, in the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of business assets.

5. Cookies & Local Storage

The Website uses your browser's local storage to keep you logged in, remember your cart, and maintain chat conversation history during your session. We do not currently use third-party advertising cookies or tracking pixels.

6. Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect your information. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

7. Data Retention

We retain account, order, and enquiry information for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this Policy, or as required by applicable law.

8. Your Rights

Subject to applicable law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you may have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal information. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.

9. Children's Privacy

The Website is not directed at children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by an updated "Last updated" date above.
